gen-gf-unkempt-gf-tajawal: Wobbly, loud, and a bit scruffy, Unkempt keeps its t crossbar and stem matched in weight, with gaps that stop c from collapsing into o. Tajawal stays quiet beside it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-tasa-orbiter: Hand-bent and bold, Unkempt takes the lead. TASA Orbiter, a plain sans, keeps its small counters unclogged while the heading's strokes all end at one measured thickness.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-teachers: Scrappy and loud, Unkempt keeps its t crossbar and stem matched, while Teachers draws thin steel-rod letters whose ink strokes taper out before touching. A long page of it would feel light and modern.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-telex: Telex brings curvy, unclamped letters in clean sans-serif form, set against a heading with no hairlines at all. Telex would read smoothly over a long page, with Unkempt only announcing the start.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-tenor-sans: Tenor Sans reads light but visible in its strokes, like a lettering pen held steady, with c tips that never creep toward touching. Against Unkempt's flat, unmodulated weight, that gentle variation is what sets the pair apart.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-tirra: Expressive Unkempt shouts in a single unit-width stroke, its t crossbar matching its stem. And Tirra, a plain sans with round forms like open parentheses, gives that shout somewhere quiet to land.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-titillium-web: Approachable Titillium Web sets its stroke ends far apart, a low-contrast sans-serif that stays out of the way. Unkempt skims along with a stroke weight that never changes, while Titillium Web does the patient work of reading.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-tomorrow: Tomorrow reads with bowls that open like a cupped palm of clay, tidy sans-serif letters with little fuss. And Unkempt's neatly bent pipe-cleaner texture gives way to that steadiness, so a long page feels settled.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-trispace: Sparse, widely set letters make Trispace read slowly and spaciously, its curves opening outward instead of curling in. Trispace, a plain sans, gives Unkempt's wire-bent look plenty of room to stand out above it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Unkempt's t keeps crossbar and stem matched in weight, and its gaps stop c from looking like o. Tsukimi Rounded, a plain sans of open-parenthesis curves, settles the page underneath with parallel stroke edges.
